privacyPolicy: Sieve Buddy sends data only to the mail server you connect it to. Directly: Proton Mail (mail.proton.me, mail-api.proton.me) and, for a captcha, verify.proton.me in your browser. Through your own Sieve Buddy service: only that service, at the address you enter. It sends your sign-in (as an SRP proof, never the plain password), your Sieve scripts and, for a rule from a mail, the headers of that mail that the rule uses. A session token, your settings and the history of your scripts are stored locally in Thunderbird. There is no analytics, tracking or third party.
reviewerNotes:
How to test without an account: open the add-on's options page (Sieve Buddy manager) and choose "Without signing in (editor only)". The editor, live check, outline, formatter, rule assistant and Test mail simulator then work on a local script.

Services contacted: Proton Mail's web API (https://mail.proton.me, https://mail-api.proton.me), the same one Proton's web client uses, after the user signs in. Optionally a self-hosted Sieve Buddy service at an address the user enters; that host permission is requested at runtime through optional_permissions.

Bundled third-party libraries, copied unmodified from npm by scripts/vendor.mjs:
- CodeMirror 5.65.18 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/codemirror/v/5.65.18): addon/vendor/codemirror/
- bcryptjs 2.4.3 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/bcryptjs/v/2.4.3): addon/vendor/bcrypt.min.js, the dist file as published, used for Proton's SRP password hashing.

All other code is plain, unminified JavaScript. The package is built with `npm run build` (web-ext build) without any transformation.
